**Introduction to Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd.**

Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading high-tech chemical enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of cyclodextrin and its derivatives. Located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone of Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, the company benefits from a strategic geographic position with convenient access to major transportation networks, facilitating efficient logistics and global trade. Established with a commitment to innovation and quality, Huike has rapidly emerged as a key player in the cyclodextrin industry, serving diverse sectors including pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, cosmetics, agriculture, and environmental protection.

With a strong focus on technological advancement, Huike boasts a state-of-the-art production facility equipped with advanced manufacturing processes and stringent quality control systems. The company adheres to international standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 22000, and GMP, ensuring that its products meet the highest levels of safety, purity, and performance. Huike’s product portfolio includes a wide range of cyclodextrin derivatives, such as hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HP-β-CD), sulfobutyl ether beta-cyclodextrin (SBE-β-CD), and methyl-beta-cyclodextrin (M-β-CD), which are widely used for drug delivery, flavor encapsulation, and pollutant removal, among other applications.

Driven by a team of experienced scientists, engineers, and industry experts, Huike is dedicated to fostering long-term partnerships with clients worldwide. The company’s customer-centric approach, combined with its robust R&D capabilities, enables it to provide tailored solutions that address the unique needs of each industry. As a socially responsible enterprise, Huike also prioritizes environmental sustainability and safety, implementing eco-friendly practices throughout its operations.

With a vision to become a global leader in cyclodextrin technology, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. continues to expand its market presence, delivering innovative and high-quality products that contribute to advancements in science, health, and industry.
